<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Mars.Interfaces</id>
    <version>6.0.0</version>
    <title>Mars.Interfaces</title>
    <authors>Daniel Glake</authors>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <projectUrl>https://www.mars-group.org/</projectUrl>
    <description>This package contains the most used interfaces when a multi-agent simulation is created.

            For more details how to use MARS, please use the documentation:
            https://www.mars-group.org/docs/tutorial/intro</description>
    <copyright>MARS GROUP 2024</copyright>
    <tags>simulation agent layer interfaces</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/MARS-Group-HAW/life" commit="a119b7d629c6582a30f1843b14b79e57efebf19f" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Mars.Base" version="6.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Mars.IO" version="6.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Mars.Numerics" version="6.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MessagePack" version="2.5.140" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="NetTopologySuite.Features" version="2.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
